Climate Knowledge Graph has structured the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change's&nbsp;(IPCC) *Sixth&nbsp;Assessment&nbsp;Report&nbsp;(AR6)* as a Wikibase&nbsp;knowledge&nbsp;graph.

The knowledge graph is made of five datasets:

1. [Text corpus](data/corpus-ar6.html): Structured hierarchy of AR6 reports, chapters, divisions, and full text.
2. [Bibliography](data/bibliographic-ar6.html): Bibliographic information for reports and chapters.
3. [Glossary](data/glossary-ar6.html): Terms and definitions for climate concepts.
4. [Acronyms](data/acronyms-ar6.html): Acronym index with expanded forms and references.
5. [Authors](data/authors-ar6.html): Author identities and links to reports.

## An invitation to data scientists 

The knowledge graph acts as a structural (syntactic) framework for data scientists to add Linked&nbsp;Open&nbsp;Data&nbsp;(LOD) about the scientific findings contained in the report.  

Add to the knowledge graph or make use of the data yourself. 

[Find out more](get-involved.html){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

## How the knowledge graph is made  

**Web to Wikibase:** ClimateKG has made a software pipeline to structure text corpora like the IPCC AR6 report.

> The AR6 report is web scraped from the IPCC AR6 website and follows a **CSV&nbsp;→&nbsp;XML/DTD&nbsp;→&nbsp;Wikibase** import pipeline. An Entity-Relationship&nbsp;Model (ER&nbsp;Model) maps every DTD element to a confirmed Wikibase property. 

::: {.callout-note}
## Pipeline Formula

**Web scrape + ER model = knowledge graph**
:::

The steps&mdash;tools and resources: 

| Tools & Resources | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [CKG Scrape](ckg-scrape.html) | Web scraping workflow used to extract and structure the IPCC AR6 report. |
| [Datasets](datasets.html) | [Corpus](data/corpus-ar6.html) · [Authors](data/authors-ar6.html) · [Acronyms](data/acronyms-ar6.html) · [Bibliography](data/bibliographic-ar6.html) · [Glossary](data/glossary-ar6.html) |
| [ER Model](research_data/data-xml-dtd/erm/erm-diagram.html) | Interactive entity-relationship diagram — fullscreen, zoomable, and showing the corpus hierarchy: Work (Q2) → Report Series (Q3) → Report (Q4) → Text Division (Q5) → Chapter (Q6) |
| [XML/DTD](ckg-data.html) | Validated XML and DTD layer for structuring data before import into Wikibase, with XSLT transformation for reusable outputs. |
| [Knowledge&nbsp;Graph](https://climatekg.tibwiki.io/) | Wikibase for structured data and linked relationships across the report corpus. |
| [Browse&nbsp;Report](https://climatekg.tibwiki.io/) | MediaWiki for browsing the report, page structure, and connected content. |
| Access the data | [SPARQL](https://climatekg.tibwiki.io/query/) · [XML](xml-html-documentation.html) · [APIs](https://climatekg.tibwiki.io/w/api.php) · Data dumps |
| Access full text | [MediaWiki API](https://climatekg.tibwiki.io/w/api.php) · [XSLT transformation](xml-html-documentation.html) |
